title: A strict four-row permanent inequality and permutation moments
summary: We prove a permanent inequality with exponent strictly below two for laws on S 4 sufficiently close to uniform and with exactly uniform coordinate marginals. Applied to a four-row recursion, it shows that an absolute number of coordinate sweeps brings the full permutation of the Thorp shuffle on $`N=2^d`$ cards to total-variation distance tending to zero from uniform as $`N\to\infty`$. Thus the mixing time has the optimal order $`O(\log N)`$ in physical shuffles.
family_title: Optimal logarithmic mixing of the Thorp shuffle

review.reason: Proves a permanent inequality and bounds mixing time of the Thorp shuffle.
